title: Pan-Seared Canadian Cod with Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared Canadian cod served with crispy skewers.

ingredients.name: Vegetable skewers
ingredients.notes: Contains kissed bell peppers, crispy onions, and other vegetables

instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the cod for 2-3 minutes per side, then transfer to the oven.
Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, brush the vegetable skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill or broil the skewers until crispy and tender.
Serve the cod with the skewers and a squeeze of lemon.
